conditions.name: light
conditions.note: near-dark; faint phosphorescence on the wet walls gives dim silhouettes only. Lighting the brazier creates a bright pool but blinds night-sight beyond it and announces position.

conditions.name: water
conditions.note: ABUNDANT and DEEP. The whole undercroft below the walkway is flooded with cold black water. Drinkable at risk, throwable, douses anything, deep enough to drown in. This is the floor's central resource and the answer to 'is there water?' — yes, overwhelmingly.

description: A ring of cracked stone walkway just above the waterline, the only dry footing near the entrance. The flood fills the undercroft below it. A toppled brazier-stand lies half in the water; a coil of rotted rope hangs from a wall ring.

exits: the descending stair behind (back to floor 1's slab) and the submerged passage forward — the only way across is along the walkway ring or through the water itself

things.name: the flood itself (black water, undercroft-deep)
things.use: ABUNDANT water — drink (risky, mineral/foul), throw, douse, submerge. The floor's defining resource. Cold and deep; falling in is a real hazard for VIT 6.
things.note: this is the floor's pre-decided water answer: YES, everywhere, deep. Exploitable against the Sentry (heat/dry) and the Glut (dry stone).

things.name: toppled brazier-stand (half in water)
things.use: the iron basket still holds dry-ish char and a flint-scrape striker bracket — a FIRE source can be coaxed here with effort (INT/FIN). The one heat seed on a water floor.
things.note: key item: heat is the Sentry's bane; this is where it comes from. Lighting it is an action, not free.

things.name: coil of rotted rope (wall ring)
things.use: ~4m of rope; frays under load >~80kg but holds a careful climber or a thrown lashing. Cover/leverage/retrieval tool.

things.name: loose walkway slabs (cracked, along the ring)
things.use: pry one free as a thrown slab (heavy ranged, FIN) or a shield-board (improvised cover, +1 physDef while braced)
things.note: prying takes a turn; leaves a gap in the footing

things.name: rusted bracket-spikes (in the wall)
things.use: none useful — too corroded to pull free intact; crumble
